note: Two numbers describe the Aggregate Balance on any given date. 'forecast_for_today_made_yesterday' is what the HKMA published for this date on the previous session, recorded here with the date it was made. 'aggregate_balance' is the settled figure, which is not available until the date itself. Which of the two a point-in-time analysis may use is a modelling decision this file does not make. HIBOR fixings are recorded at 11:15 a.m. on the date shown, per the HKMA's own field documentation.
